hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: The user's message contains Hebrew. If your reply is in Hebrew, fully or mixed with another language, follow these rules so it renders right-to-left: open every paragraph, list item, heading, table cell and bold lead-in with a Hebrew word, never with a Latin-script term, statute name, product name, command or path.
